GracePrinciples.Principle: Approved change plans are immutable during execution.
Backend or agent failure ends an execution attempt, not a durable task or approved change.
Observed write scope and fresh product-path evidence are mandatory for acceptance.
Always retain an early runnable end-to-end vertical proving slice.
Event sourcing is opt-in and must not automatically become the storage model for every domain.
Workflow truth, architecture decisions, runtime truth, and CI policy have distinct owners.
No green result may be obtained by silently skipping required evidence.
